verdict.rationale: Honeycomb clearly supports alerting on telemetry via Triggers and SLO burn alerts, with routing to Slack, PagerDuty, Teams, or custom webhooks (docs-6,7,8,33). However, the evidence never documents alert grouping or silencing/muting capabilities, which are explicit parts of the story. missing for 10: explicit grouping of alerts, silencing/mute functionality for notifications, independent corroboration of alerting reliability.
